rationale: Three lenses ran over the 2-file / 47-line diff (blind, edge-case, acceptance); every story and spec criterion passes, commit format matches the guide, and the automated gates (ci-pipeline, SonarQube 0 new issues, test-harness 79 passed / 0 failed) are green. Two blind-lens concerns were refuted by measurement rather than argument: the new test is a genuine regression guard (dom-accessibility-api computes an empty accessible name for the pre-fix markup, so it fails without the aria-label), and the aria-label shadows no visible label (the Input `label` prop is unset here, so the wrapping <label> carries no text). 3 findings deferred, none blocking: (1) in the error state the accessible name was previously the error text and is now the stable field name, so the error message needs aria-describedby/aria-invalid in the shared src/components/form/Input/Input.tsx — a pre-existing 3.3.1 gap in that component, deliberately out of this 4.1.2 ticket's scope and handed to the maintainer as a follow-up alongside the three Popup.tsx defects; (2) {...field} is spread after aria-label, which is harmless today (react-hook-form's field carries only name/value/onChange/onBlur/ref) but would silently win if that ever changes; (3) the edit-mode test asserts only the accessible name and could additionally assert toHaveValue('Existing folder') to prove it is really in edit mode. 6 further concerns dismissed as refuted or non-blocking style.

business_review.notes: aria-label wins over both the empty wrapping <label> and the placeholder fallback; measured with dom-accessibility-api: "" before, "Folder name" after.

business_review.item: Selected approach: aria-label="Folder name", no visual change

business_review.item: Fix also covers the Edit Folder mode of the same modal
